name: PC Throttle
summary: Throttle, bench test and firmware update tool for novaX ESCs on a PC, through the FC or a USB-CAN adapter (Windows).

shots.caption: Main screen: throttle, ESC status, thrust stand and the live thrust chart
Update every ESC: all five ESCs on the CAN hub listed, one after another

releases.changes: New "Auto-cal every ESC" button next to "Update every ESC": auto-cals the ESCs one at a time in esc_index order, with the same bench check before each (about 22 s each, the motor turns). ESCs that report the name "AE_16S_60A" (motor-chip app V1.46-V1.50) are recognised as AE-14S. Includes the 2.1.1 pusher-beep fix.

files.notes: Needs Microsoft Edge WebView2 (built into Windows 11).

releases.changes: Fix: an ESC that was not being driven beeped "signal lost" (fault throttle_loss). In the VTOL lift mission the pusher (ESC 4) beeped the whole run. Every ESC on the bus now gets 0 in each throttle command, as ArduPilot does. Parameter writes are unaffected.

files.notes: Needs Microsoft Edge WebView2 (built into Windows 11).

releases.changes: Flight test "VTOL lift mission" drives the four lift ESCs (0-3) together; if any one goes silent, faults, draws over 30 A or does not turn within 2 s, all four stop. Other profiles and the slider still drive the chosen ESC.

files.notes: Needs Microsoft Edge WebView2 (built into Windows 11).

releases.changes: "Update every ESC" now lists every ESC on a CAN hub: names are asked one ESC at a time and asked again until they answer (before, 2 of 5 ESCs behind an FC were listed). The version and build are shown in the window.

files.notes: Needs Microsoft Edge WebView2 (built into Windows 11).
